title: Fixed local calendar labels for comments
summary: Architecture: comment labels and tooltips describe time in the reader local timezone. Problem: Yesterday compares UTC calendar dates while the tooltip uses local dates. Solution: compare local calendar dates using day ordinals so the label agrees with the reader calendar, including short and long daylight-saving days.
validation: Proposed helper fix. Cover UTC, Sao Paulo, Tokyo, local year boundaries and a daylight-saving transition. Recent minute and hour labels keep their existing behavior.
